nodes.description: Reentrancy guard flag set true before swapBack() and reset after; read in _transfer to block nested swaps.
Marketing fee recipient address, mutated by updateMarketingWallet and used as ETH recipient in swapBack().
Dev fee recipient address, mutated by updateDevWallet and used as ETH recipient in swapBack().
Threshold of contract token balance that triggers swapBack(); owner-updatable via updateSwapTokensAtAmount.
Accumulated tokens owed for liquidity; consumed and zeroed in swapBack().
Accumulated tokens owed for marketing; consumed and zeroed in swapBack().
Accumulated tokens owed for dev; consumed and zeroed in swapBack().
Total sell fee percentage, recomputed in _transfer and updateSellFees.
Sell liquidity fee percentage, dynamically overwritten inside _transfer (early sell logic).
Sell marketing fee percentage, dynamically overwritten inside _transfer (early sell logic).
Sell dev fee percentage, dynamically overwritten inside _transfer (early sell logic).
Blacklist mapping checked at the top of _transfer and writable by owner-only blacklistAccount.
First-buy timestamp per holder driving the 24h early-sell tax window in _transfer.
Last transfer block keyed by tx.origin, enforcing one purchase per block during launch.
Block number when trading was enabled; used for the anti-bot block check in _transfer.
Trading gate flag checked in _transfer; enabled once via enableTrading.
Flag controlling whether swapBack may run from _transfer.
Flag gating max-transaction and max-wallet checks in _transfer.
Owner address used by the onlyOwner modifier and read inside _transfer exclusions.
Total buy fee percentage, recomputed in updateBuyFees.
Mapping marking addresses exempt from fees; consulted in _transfer before taking fees.
Immutable Uniswap V2 router used for swaps and liquidity operations.
Immutable Uniswap V2 pair address used to classify buys/sells in _transfer.
Overridden ERC20 transfer containing limit checks, blacklist logic, tx.origin delay, timestamp-based sell tax and swapBack triggering.
Private function collecting fees, swapping tokens for ETH, sending ETH to dev and marketing via low-level calls, then adding liquidity.
Private helper approving router and swapping contract tokens for ETH.
Private helper approving router and adding ETH/token liquidity.
Owner-only airdrop that self-approves totalSupply then loops transferFrom over caller-supplied recipient/value arrays.
Owner-only one-way switch enabling trading, swaps and recording launchedAt.
Owner-only setter for sell and early-sell fee percentages plus recomputed sellTotalFees.
Owner-only setter for buy fee percentages plus recomputed buyTotalFees.
Owner-only setter writing arbitrary addresses into the _blacklist mapping.
Owner-only setter for AMM pair flags; cannot remove the primary uniswapV2Pair.
Owner-only setter toggling fee exemptions for an address.
Owner-only one-way switch disabling transfer limits.
Ownable owner-only function transferring contract ownership to a new account.
External caller identity, used as transferFrom source in Chire and via _msgSender throughout ERC20.
Origin account used as key of _holderLastTransferTimestamp for per-block purchase throttling in _transfer.
Block timestamp driving first-buy recording and the 24h early-sell tax branch in _transfer.
Low-level call forwarding ethForDev to devWallet inside swapBack, executed before state is fully settled.
Low-level call forwarding the entire contract ETH balance to marketingWallet inside swapBack.
External router call swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens with 0 slippage and block.timestamp deadline.
Loop of transferFrom calls inside Chire consuming the owner's self-granted allowance over user-supplied arrays.
Sender address parameter of _transfer.
Recipient address parameter of _transfer.
Transfer amount parameter of _transfer, reduced by the computed fee.
Recipient address array parameter of the Chire airdrop.
Amount array parameter of the Chire airdrop, scaled by 10**decimals().
Local fee amount computed in _transfer from sell/buy total fees.
Local balanceOf(address(this)) used to decide canSwap in _transfer.
Local contract token balance, capped at 20x swapTokensAtAmount, used in swapBack.
Local ETH share for devWallet computed in swapBack.
Local ETH share for marketingWallet computed in swapBack.
Local Uniswap swap path [token, WETH] built in swapTokensForEth.

edges.reason: tx.origin is used as the mapping key for _holderLastTransferTimestamp so purchase throttling depends on a caller-controlled origin account.
block.timestamp determines the 24h early-sell window and first-buy recording, making sell tax outcomes miner-influenceable.
msg.sender is the allowance owner consumed by transferFrom inside the Chire airdrop loop.
Caller identity reaches _transfer through _msgSender/balanceOf checks on from and to.
devWallet is the target of the low-level value transfer in swapBack.
marketingWallet is the target of the low-level value transfer in swapBack.
swapBack reads devWallet to compute the dev ETH payout.
swapBack reads marketingWallet to route the remaining ETH balance.
swapTokensAtAmount caps contractBalance inside swapBack.
swapTokensAtAmount gates the canSwap condition in _transfer.
tokensForLiquidity is consumed and zeroed during swapBack.
tokensForMarketing is consumed and zeroed during swapBack.
tokensForDev is consumed and zeroed during swapBack.
sellTotalFees is recomputed and used as the fee divisor/multiplier in the sell branch of _transfer.
sellLiquidityFee is overwritten in _transfer and used in fee share arithmetic.
sellMarketingFee is overwritten in _transfer and used in fee share arithmetic.
sellDevFee is overwritten in _transfer and used in fee share arithmetic.
_blacklist is read for both from and to at the start of the overridden _transfer.
_holderFirstBuyTimestamp drives the early-sell tax branch in _transfer.
_holderLastTransferTimestamp is read and written under the transfer-delay check in _transfer.
launchedAt participates in the anti-bot block-number check in _transfer.
tradingActive gates transfers that are not fee-exempt in _transfer.
swapEnabled is part of the canSwap condition triggering swapBack.
limitsInEffect activates the max-transaction and max-wallet enforcement block.
buyTotalFees is used as the buy fee multiplier/divisor in _transfer.
_isExcludedFromFees decides whether fees are taken and whether trading checks are skipped.
owner() is compared against from and to inside the limits block of _transfer.
uniswapV2Pair determines isBuy/isSell classification and anti-bot exclusions in _transfer.
uniswapV2Router is approved and called by swapTokensForEth.
uniswapV2Router is approved and called by addLiquidity.
_transfer invokes swapBack while swapping is true, entering the ETH payout path.
swapBack calls swapTokensForEth to convert tokens to ETH.
swapBack calls addLiquidity when liquidity tokens and ETH remain.
swapBack performs an external low-level call to devWallet, handing control to an arbitrary address mid-execution.
swapBack performs an external low-level call forwarding the whole ETH balance to marketingWallet.
swapTokensForEth makes an external router call with 0 slippage and block.timestamp deadline.
addLiquidity performs an external router call via addLiquidityETH.
Chire loops transferFrom calls after self-approving totalSupply to the owner.
transferOwnership rewrites the _owner state variable guarded by onlyOwner.
The current _owner is the authorization subject of the onlyOwner modifier on transferOwnership.
removeLimits irreversibly clears limitsInEffect under onlyOwner.
excludeFromFees writes fee exemptions into _isExcludedFromFees under onlyOwner.
blacklistAccount writes arbitrary addresses into _blacklist under onlyOwner, blocking their transfers.
updateSellFees recomputes sellTotalFees from caller-supplied fee components.
updateBuyFees recomputes buyTotalFees from caller-supplied fee components.
enableTrading permanently opens trading and can never be reverted.
enableTrading turns on the swapBack trigger.
enableTrading records launchedAt for the anti-bot window.
The from parameter feeds every check and the final super._transfer call.
The to parameter feeds blacklist, limit and buy/sell classification logic.
The amount parameter is reduced by the computed fee before the final transfer.
fees is derived from amount times buy/sell total fees divided by 100.
The computed fees value is subtracted from amount inside _transfer.
contractTokenBalance computed in _transfer determines whether swapBack is invoked.
The recipients array bounds and indexes the airdrop transferFrom loop.
The values array is multiplied by 10**decimals() to size each airdrop transfer.
contractBalance caps and scales the liquidity token math in swapBack.
ethForDev is the exact value forwarded by the low-level devWallet call.
ethForMarketing is derived from ethBalance and tokensForMarketing in swapBack.
The path array is supplied to the router swap call in swapTokensForEth.

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter only exists inside _transfer and must be folded into that function node.
The to parameter only exists inside _transfer and must be folded into that function node.
The amount parameter is local to _transfer and must be folded into that function node.
The recipients array belongs solely to the Chire airdrop function.
The values array belongs solely to the Chire airdrop function.
The fees local variable is computed and consumed only inside _transfer.
contractTokenBalance is a local inside _transfer used for the canSwap decision.
contractBalance is a local inside swapBack used for the fee split math.
ethForDev is the value passed to the devWallet low-level call and belongs to that unsafe operation.
ethForMarketing is a local inside swapBack used to size the marketing payout.
The path array is a local inside swapTokensForEth supplied to the router.
